title: "2026-08-07 — Phase 0.75 opened"

## State transition

Phase 0.5 reading reconciliation is complete. Its successful ledger and the successful
Phase 0 bootstrap ledger are now completed records, not active authorities. One Phase
0.75 plan is active for the bounded upstream-audit, experiment-harness, and
protocol-lock phase.

## Boundary at opening

T00 repairs lifecycle validation and public state only. It does not inspect or clone an
upstream repository, register an experiment, call a model or API, install a browser,
run a benchmark, download a checkpoint, or mutate cloud resources. All execution and
paid-compute permissions remain false.

## Opening gate (completed)

T00 must pass lifecycle regressions, independent spec-conformance review, and the full
local parity gate before a separate static-audit or harness workstream may begin.

Phase 0.75 later completed through T06. See the 2026-08-08 Phase 1 opening note for the
current gate; this page remains the historical opening record.
